title: Import from a JSON/JSON Lines File

text_run.content: (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight, human-readable data format that machines can parse and generate easily. Language-independent, it follows conventions familiar to C-family language programmers, making it an ideal data interchange format.
A JSON Line is a text format where each line is a complete, valid JSON object, making it easy to process data streams incrementally with standard text tools.
